verdict.rationale: Docusign documents an official MCP connector (with Claude) that lets natural-language agents retrieve agreement context and trigger IAM workflow actions, and a separate AI-Assisted Review chat interface for reviewing/redlining agreements. These are real but narrow slices of the product (workflow triggers, contract review) rather than full natural-language operation of core eSignature flows like sending/signing envelopes. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control over core send/sign/manage envelope operations, broader coverage beyond MCP/AI-review, and independent hands-on confirmation of the MCP connector working in practice.
